description: Calculate kgCO₂e for an activity. Pass an emission_factor with at minimum `activity_id` (from search_factors) or `id`, plus the required `parameters` (e.g., `{ energy: 200, energy_unit: "kWh" }`). Returns CO₂e + breakdown.

emission_factor.description: Selector object — at minimum {activity_id: "..."} or {id: "..."}. May add region, year, source for disambiguation.

parameters.description: Activity quantities matching the factor's required unit type (e.g., {energy:200, energy_unit:"kWh"}).

name: estimate_emissions
